reason: I have 20 clients and one account takes only 5 groups and one sheet, so I would be juggling four Google logins and still typing everything into Jurnal myself. I might burn the 40 free documents on one client to see how it reads handwritten nota, but I would not pay for it this month.
objection: It is built for one business owner, not for a bookkeeper. I need each client in its own sheet under one account, and an export into Jurnal or Accurate, otherwise I have just moved the retyping from WhatsApp photos to a Google Sheet. I also cannot resell it with a margin if it looks like a cheap consumer bot.
would_change_my_mind: An accountant plan: one login, 20+ clients each with a separate sheet, an import file Jurnal or Accurate accepts, and a reseller or volume price so I can bill it on top of my bookkeeping fee.
